title: One caveman's sight sets off the others near the player
description: A caveman walking back towards the player sees him while still far off. It walks on, but a hawkman walled in under the player's feet, which can't see him, starts charging: a caveman's sight sets off every caveman and hawkman near the player, whichever saw him.
